title: Two-open Mayer--Vietoris vanishing for inverse images of module sheaves
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$, let $X,Z$ be schemes of universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $i:Z\to X$ be a morphism, and let $J$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For an open $T\subseteq X$, write $F_T$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of $(\operatorname{pr}_1:T\times_XZ\to T)^*(J|_T)$, and write $F$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of $i^*J$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $U,V\subseteq X$ be opens with $U\cup V=X$, and let $r\in\mathbb N$. If $H^{r+1}(F_U)$, $H^{r+1}(F_V)$ and $H^r(F_{U\cap V})$ are subsingleton, then $H^{r+1}(F)$ is subsingleton, with H understood as Sheaf.H [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No affineness, separatedness, closed-immersion, injectivity, or torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Proof, Mayer--Vietoris induction, with the affine vanishing supplied explicitly; coefficient and inverse-image identifications from Tag 03D3

proof.text: Base change of each open inclusion is an open immersion; its image is the inverse-image open in Z. The two images cover Z, and the base change of U ∩ V identifies with their intersection. Identify each base-change scheme with its image.
Inverse-image composition and forgetting module structure identify the restrictions of the underlying abelian sheaf of i^*J with the displayed sheaves; transport across the scheme isomorphisms.

Apply the two-open Mayer--Vietoris vanishing criterion to the abelian sheaf on Z. The natural comparison between Sheaf.H and derived global sections transports each of the three given vanishings to the derived-cohomology criterion.
In the exact segment H^r(intersection) → H^(r+1)(Z) → H^(r+1)(U) × H^(r+1)(V), both outer groups are zero, hence the middle group is zero.

theorem Etale.subsingleton_H_of_two_open_pullback_cover
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (J : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) (r : ℕ)
    (hU : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((pullback.fst U.ι i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          ((U.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J))) (r + 1)))
    (hV : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((pullback.fst V.ι i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          ((V.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J))) (r + 1)))
    (hI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((pullback.fst (U ⊓ V).ι i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          (((U ⊓ V).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J))) r))
    : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)) (r + 1))
